# wire-item-agentmessage

Provider: Codex.
Provider version: checked-in schema at db88af8b44ed712a99283bf5fd147ea072700b00.
Source class: constructed example.

Covers ThreadItem `agentMessage`. Completed native snapshot is authoritative. Current Nano retains raw item; category and role may fall back to unclassified/assistant. Optional fields and nested variants are not exhaustively instantiated.

Expected output is a research oracle for the proposed standard, not current Nano output. IDs beginning `item-` are fixture-local logical IDs. Nulls mean no evidence. Captured arrays may be reduced to four entries; prose, paths, and identities are neutralized.
